claim_verbatim: From 3 Jan 2027, a Democratic Congress will control the purse. The White House will run the same program against it from the inside. That is Project 2027.
context: Opening section, after describing the Aug 2025 $4.9 billion foreign-aid pocket rescission and the 25 Sep 2026 $567.4 million refugee-assistance use of the same method, both found illegal by GAO. 'The same program' = holding back money, late cancellations and stripping job protections from policy staff (Vought's OMB tools).
resolution_criterion: YES (his call right) if, between 3 Jan 2027 and 30 Sep 2027 (the remainder of fiscal year 2027 under the Democratic Congress), the White House withholds appropriated funds or sends a rescission request so late in the fiscal year that the money expires before the 45-day clock can run (a pocket rescission), as shown by a GAO Impoundment Control Act decision or a special message to Congress under 2 U.S.C. 683. NO if neither occurs in that window. A rescission request sent early enough for the 45-day clock to run, with the money then released, does not count.
